versions.content: Applicability of DiagnosticDataIdentifier . supportIn- foByte The attribute DiagnosticDataIdentifier . supportInfoByte may ex- ist if the value of DiagnosticDataIdentifier . id is in the range 0xF400-0xF4FF . A typical case for the existence of DiagnosticDataIdentifier . supportIn- foByte is the understanding that the DiagnosticDataIdentifier is relevant for OBD and the DiagnosticDataIdentifier . id is in the designated range.
